description: This file implements a specialized store for distributed process coordination using an etcd backend, providing methods for setting, getting, incrementing, and waiting on keys, tailored for integration with PyTorch distributed communication.

classes.name: EtcdStore
classes.description: A custom store class that interfaces with etcd to provide a key-value store with atomic operations and wait capabilities for distributed coordination.

methods.name: cas_delay()
methods.description: Introduces a small random delay to reduce CAS (Compare-And-Set) failures in etcd operations.

methods.name: EtcdStore.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EtcdStore with an etcd client, key prefix, and optional timeout.

methods.name: EtcdStore.set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in etcd, encoding both key and value into base64.

methods.name: EtcdStore.get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key from etcd, with optional waiting until the key is published or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: EtcdStore.add
methods.description: Atomically increments a numeric value stored at a key, creating the key if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: EtcdStore.wait
methods.description: Blocks execution until all specified keys are available or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: EtcdStore.check
methods.description: Checks if all specified keys are currently present in the store.

methods.name: str _encode(self, value)
methods.description: Encodes a string or bytes into a base64 string for safe storage.

methods.name: bytes _decode(self, value)
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string back into bytes.

methods.name: _try_wait_get(self, b64_keys, override_timeout=None)
methods.description: Helper function to attempt retrieval of multiple keys, waiting via watch if necessary, with timeout handling.

methods.name: __init__( self, etcd_client, etcd_store_prefix, timeout: datetime.timedelta | None = None, )
wait(self, keys, override_timeout: datetime.timedelta | None = None)

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, etcd_client, etcd_store_prefix, timeout: datetime.timedelta | None = None, )

ctags.name: add
ctags.pattern: /^    def add(self, key, num: int) -> int:$/

ctags.name: wait
ctags.pattern: /^    def wait(self, keys, override_timeout: datetime.timedelta | None = None):$/
